data.desc: Velo3D designs and builds metal additive manufacturing systems and production services in the United States for the defense, aerospace and energy industries. Its Sapphire printers, Flow print preparation software and Assure quality assurance software are designed to produce complex metal parts repeatably across machines and sites. Velo, Velo3D, Sapphire and Intelligent Fusion are registered trademarks of Velo3D, Inc. Flow and Assure are trademarks of Velo3D, Inc.
